newsitem.title: UK: EU seen awarding up to 60,000 T sugar at tender.
newsitem.headline: EU seen awarding up to 60,000 T sugar at tender.

text.p: The European Union (EU) is expected to award as much as 60,000 tonnes of current series white sugar at its weekly tender later on Wednesday, traders said.
The EU awarded only 17,000 tonnes in its last tender on February 19.

I don't think there'll be a big quantity this week because the dollar weakened overnight and the market is looking a bit shaky as well," said one trader, estimating a range between 30,000 and 60,000 tonnes.
Another trader was more cautious and forecast between 20,000 and 30,000 tonnes.
This week's maximum restitution level was estimated at 44.471 Ecus (European currency units) per 100 kilos of sugar after the 44.008 Ecus awarded last week.
Licences are currently valid until the end of July. --Jeremy Smith, London Newsroom +44 171 542 8064
